# NordKiln
> Rent outdoor and winter gear in Northern Norway. Peer-to-peer rental of skis, snowshoes, snowboards, winter clothes, hiking/camping gear and wet/dry suits from locals in Troms (Tromsø, Balsfjord, Lyngen), expanding to Senja and Lofoten. Delivery to cabins/Airbnbs or pickup.

- Owners list for free (0% fee). Renters pay a 15% service fee on top of the owner's price (minimum 49 NOK per booking).
- Booking is request-based: send a request on the site, the owner confirms, then total price and payment details are sent by email. No payment on the website yet.
- No insurance or payment guarantee; deposit and damage are agreed between owner and renter.
- Languages: English (https://nordkiln.dev/), Norwegian (https://nordkiln.dev/no/), German (https://nordkiln.dev/de/).
- Contact: scan.nordkiln@mail.grokbot.com

## Current listings
- Völkl touring ski set with skins and boots: 450 NOK/day + renter fee, Balsfjord, pickup or delivery
- Cross-country skis: 250 NOK/day + renter fee, Balsfjord, pickup or delivery
- Snowshoes: 150 NOK/day + renter fee, Balsfjord, pickup or delivery
Live data: https://nordkiln.dev/listings.json
